core: value, color, size, shape, texture, space, and directional contrast

claims.claim: Contrast is a relationship of noticeable difference among visual elements.
An area can be made emphatic by contrast in size, color, texture, shape, or other visual features.
Visual analysis can compare contrast among texture, light, color, form, line, and space.
Contrast can support a qualified observation about attention but cannot alone prove historical meaning or maker intent.
Contrast and emphasis are related but distinct: contrast is difference, while emphasis is an area that stands out.
